about_item: Be Prepared Anywhere: The Kurgo Dog First Aid Kit keeps you ready for cuts, choking, and emergencies with a dog first aid travel kit featuring a mesh compartment system and 50 essential pieces
Compact & Durable Design: Built with durable oxford fabric, this compact pet emergency gear includes an integrated hook and bottle opener for easy hanging and quick access
Organized & Versatile: Features three interior mesh compartments, a zippered pocket, and parachute cord utility to keep pet bandages, gloves, and tools organized in your portable pet kit
Designed for Real-World Adventures: Kurgo gear is built to solve everyday challenges with dogs, making travel, walks, and outdoor play safer, easier, and more fun for both of you
Durable Gear, Lifetime Promise: Engineered for longevity and reliability, every Kurgo product is crafted with rugged materials and backed by our industry-leading lifetime warranty

authors_reviews.title: Bought for humans , not for pets.
authors_reviews.text: I know its marketed for pets. But everything in here you can use on yourselves as well. I like that its a roll up first aid kit, very spacious , I love the zippered pouches. I'm going to add a few things its missing, like neoprorin. Great first aid kit for my car.

authors_reviews.title: The most comprehensive while still being travel or bugout friendly
authors_reviews.text: Having built my own extensive first aid kits & trauma kits for both hiking and bugout bags...1. This is the only one at a decent price point and minimal real estate for your hiking backpacks.2. It's also the only one with an icepack and little first aid manual included.3. I may just swap out the tweezers for the Uncle Bill's Sliver Grippers.No regrets on this purchase! Taking it on our trip to a remote cabin up in the mountains and feeling confident with our pup.
